class="typography-module_body-s-bold__FIoxj typography-module_md_body-m-bold__K8ZVr typography-module_lg_body-l-bold__WMAlJ">Red Bull have announced the signing of Robin Raikkonen, son of 2007 World Champion Kimi Raikkonen, to their driver development programme.</span></p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">The 11-year-old, who is also known by the nickname 'Ace', will officially start working with the team from 2027 onwards to further his racing career.</p></div></div><div id="unruly-configuration" class="relative"><!--$!--><template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING"></template><!--/$--></div><div class="flex flex-col content-rich-text max-w-full md:max-w-para-md lg:max-w-para-lg m-auto"><div class="flex flex-col gap-rem-12 md:gap-rem-16 lg:gap-rem-24"><p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">Red Bull have proven over the years that they have one of the strongest junior programmes in Formula 1, with their graduates including Max Verstappen, Carlos Sainz and this season's sole rookie Arvid Lindblad.</p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">Identified as "one of the most promising young talents of his generation", the young Raikkonen has already demonstrated his skill in various karting championships and will be supported through the ranks.</p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">Former Ferrari racer Raikkonen said: "We are all thrilled and excited that Robin has been chosen to further his racing path as a member of the Red Bull Junior Team. Laurent [Mekies] and everyone else at Red Bull have been incredibly supportive throughout all our discussions.</p></div></div><span class="ImageCard-module_imagecard__3msoQ"><span class="ImageCard-module_image__yQ3ec ImageCard-module_rounded__hcjlw"><img src="https://media.formula1.com/image/upload/c_lfill,w_3392/q_auto/v1740000001/fom-website/2026/Red%20Bull/SI202609090427.webp" alt="SI202609090427.jpg"/></span><span class="ImageCard-module_footer__P-ORm typography-module_desktop-label-regular__aWvx8">The Finn is the latest youngster to sign for Red Bull</span></span><div class="flex flex-col content-rich-text max-w-full md:max-w-para-md lg:max-w-para-lg m-auto"><div class="flex flex-col gap-rem-12 md:gap-rem-16 lg:gap-rem-24"><p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">"They offer a compelling and comprehensive programme to develop and nurture Robin’s progress over the coming years and provide him with all the experience required to develop his natural talent, which has amply been displayed in all his karting endeavours to date.</p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">"Red Bull’s Junior Team has had years of incredible success. Its alumni include Sebastian Vettel and Verstappen amongst many others. It is thus with great humility that Robin joins this illustrious programme, and he will dedicate all his efforts to warrant the trust that Red Bull is placing in him.”</p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">"Robin has already demonstrated exceptional ability in karting," added Red Bull Team Principal Mekies. "His speed, racecraft and natural talent have established him as one of the most promising young drivers in his age group. At the same time, he impresses with his maturity, his calm approach and his clear focus on driving.</p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">"Our goal is to develop him step by step, without placing any unnecessary pressure on his shoulders. The path through motorsport is a long one, and we will give him the time, support and resources he needs to maximise his potential.</p>
<p class="typography-module_body-s-regular__ul7F5 typography-module_md_body-m-regular__d9VRg typography-module_lg_body-l-regular__dPa5z">"We strongly believe that talent can thrive when supported by the right people, the right culture and the right environment. That is what we are committed to providing Robin as he continues his development. We are very much looking forward to taking the next steps in his journey together with Robin and his family."</p></div></div><div class="PromoCard-module_promocard__-Loef PromoCard-module_d__9BF2f https://www.formula1.com:443/en/latest/a.visible_text: Kimi Raikkonen's son Robin joins Red Bull's driver development programme Skip to content Race Series Authentics (opens in a new tab) Store (opens in a new tab) Tickets (opens in a new tab) Hospitality (opens in a new tab) Experiences (opens in a new tab) Arcade (opens in a new tab) (opens in a new tab) Sign In Subscribe Schedule Results Standings Drivers Teams F1 Unlocked Red Bull Racing Kimi Raikkonen Road to F1 Kimi Raikkonen's son Robin joins Red Bull's driver development programme Red Bull have bolstered their junior driver stable with the addition of Robin Raikkonen, son of the 2007 F1 World Champion. Sep 09, 2026 10:17am UTC Red Bull have announced the signing of Robin Raikkonen, son of 2007 World Champion Kimi Raikkonen, to their driver development programme. The 11-year-old, who is also known by the nickname 'Ace', will officially start working with the team from 2027 onwards to further his racing career. Red Bull have proven over the years that they have one of the strongest junior programmes in Formula 1, with their graduates including Max Verstappen, Carlos Sainz and this season's sole rookie Arvid Lindblad. Identified as "one of the most promising young talents of his generation", the young Raikkonen has already demonstrated his skill in various karting championships and will be supported through the ranks. Former Ferrari racer Raikkonen said: "We are all thrilled and excited that Robin has been chosen to further his racing path as a member of the Red Bull Junior Team. Laurent [Mekies] and everyone else at Red Bull have been incredibly supportive throughout all our discussions. The Finn is the latest youngster to sign for Red Bull "They offer a compelling and comprehensive programme to develop and nurture Robin’s progress over the coming years and provide him with all the experience required to develop his natural talent, which has amply been displayed in all his karting endeavours to date. "Red Bull’s Junior Team has had years of incredible success. Its alumni include Sebastian Vettel and Verstappen amongst many others. It is thus with great humility that Robin joins this illustrious programme, and he will dedicate all his efforts to warrant the trust that Red Bull is placing in him.” "Robin has already demonstrated exceptional ability in karting," added Red Bull Team Principal Mekies. "His speed, racecraft and natural talent have established him as one of the most promising young drivers in his age group. At the same time, he impresses with his maturity, his calm approach and his clear focus on driving. "Our goal is to develop him step by step, without placing any unnecessary pressure on his shoulders. The path through motorsport is a long one, and we will give him the time, support and resources he needs to maximise his potential. "We strongly believe that talent can thrive when supported by the right people, the right culture and the right environment. That is what we are committed to providing Robin as he continues his development. We are very much looking forward to taking the next steps in his journey together with Robin and his family."
